Priya (CSM): FYI Kinetic Labs (Alex) pinged me — they want to add 3 new internal teams (Search, Analytics, Docs) and start ingesting webhook data for contextual embeddings. Asked for a ramp timeline and whether we can support burst capacity for month-end reports.
Alex (Kinetic Labs): Hey team — we're happy with Redwood so far. Next quarter we'll spin up Search and Analytics teams (~40k requests/day combined) + a small Docs team for semantic search. Need embeddings and streaming responses for live ops. Any blockers on cadence or infra?
Devon (AM): Nice! Renewal in 3 months — this expansion looks like a good upsell signal. Do we have a rough seat/throughput quote to present? Also confirm any contract/commit changes if they want guaranteed capacity.
Owen (Solutions): @Priya can you share example payloads and expected sequence lengths? For embeddings vs generation mix, rough QPS helps. For 40k req/day that's ~0.5 r/s avg but bursty. We should recommend model families + quantization suggestions.
Priya (CSM): Payloads attached (pseudo) below. Mostly short docs (300-1k tokens) for embeddings, and chat/generation for Search with streaming. They want <200ms p50 for generation where possible.
Priya (CSM): ```json
{
  "team": "search",
  "avg_tokens": 600,
  "daily_requests": 20000,
  "embedding_ratio": 0.6
}
```
Kai (Infra): 200ms p50 for 600-token gen on hosted is ambitious. Two options: 1) Dedicated pool with pinned capacity (recommended) or 2) Hosted with burst and fallback to cheaper model for non-critical traffic. For embeddings we can do batching and caching.
Aria (Support): We'll need to schedule enablement sessions per team. Recommend 2x 60-min workshops: embeddings best practices + streaming integration. Also prepare runbook for webhook ingestion failures.
Devon (AM): Alex — will you be able to commit to a 6-12 month reserved capacity if we provide pricing? That helps guarantee latency and cost predictability.
Alex (Kinetic Labs): We can commit to a 6-month tier if latency SLAs are in the contract. Interested in dedicated for Search at first.
Owen (Solutions): Draft recommendation for Priya: Dedicated small pool (1-2 cards) for Search with autoscale policy to handle month-end bursts, hosted embeddings with aggressive batching for Analytics, docs on quantized models for cost. Estimated delta: +25% to their current spend.
Priya (CSM): Can someone run a quick perf estimate and pricing ballpark? Need to get back to Alex by EOD Friday.
Kai (Infra): I'll run capacity calc and a config snippet for autoscale. Quick note: enable prefix KV cache for Search and set max_batch_tokens=4096 for embeddings to reduce cost.
Kai (Infra): ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 4
  scale_metric: qps
cache:
  kv_prefix: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```
Owen (Solutions): I'll add model recs and a migration plan for streaming -> SSE/websocket.
Aria (Support): I'll draft the enablement agenda and share a Calendly link.
Priya (CSM): Thanks all — I'll confirm scope with Alex and post an update. @Devon please hold the renewal checklist open as this could shift numbers. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder: create onboarding workspace and invite Kinetic Labs emails after confirmation.
Alex (Kinetic Labs): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the workshops.
Devon (AM): I'll mark this as a high expansion opportunity and loop in finance for preliminary pricing.
Priya (CSM): Update: Alex confirmed Search dedicated pool + Analytics on hosted. Sending invoice ask and workshop times tomorrow. Will post final numbers when Kai and Owen share calc. :eyes:
